prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 2x2 animation sprite sheet: FOUR separate complete body-only poses, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Reference image is the SAME silver-haired imperial archer character. Preserve face, amber eyes, silver long flowing natural hair, small red-black-gold crown, black gold filigree armor, ruby details, white embroidered robe and red inner cape, long legs and adult 6.5-head proportions. Face NOT oily. Hair flows naturally in fine connected strands, NO layered blades. Same three-quarter camera facing screen RIGHT. 1536x1536 square if possible, exact four equal square cells. Each character INCLUDING all hair, crown and boots must fit in its own cell with at least 7% transparent safety margins and obvious transparent separation. Character head-to-foot height about 520 px of each 768 cell at identical scale. Simplify flowing cloth to two coherent tails behind him, DO NOT fill every empty area with ribbons. COMPLETE crown tips and toes, NO contact with any canvas or cell edges. ONE consistent physical body size in all cells, knees bend without zooming in. NO text, letters, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, magic, aura, bow, bowstring, arrows or long weapon: BODY ONLY! Left fist closes around only a tiny grip stub, the original bow will be composited. Right hand draws an invisible string. Real changing elbows, shoulder rotation, knees and cloth silhouettes, never four copies of one pose. Clear high-end illustrated RPG sprite rendering, genuine transparent background. Four chronological hit-to-kneel poses: 1 torso flinches backward after impact, left elbow bends holding tiny grip near chest; 2 he drops center of gravity, one knee starts folding, face grim; 3 one knee touches ground and head lowers, left fist rests near knee; 4 settled defeated kneeling bow, both legs folded, head bowed and shoulders slack, hair and cloak settle on ground. Same body scale even when kneeling, do NOT zoom crouched figure. No wounds or gore.
